paginas.texto: Sofia draws a map of everything. Her room, the school, the way to the bakery. Everything.
On Saturday she made a map of the town for a visitor who had never been there.
'Go past the museum, turn left at the bridge, and the theatre is on your right.'
'If you see the airport, you have gone too far. Everybody sees the airport at least once.'
Mateo used the map on Sunday. He arrived at the police station.
'The map is perfect,' said Sofia. 'You turned left at the wrong bridge.' There are two bridges.
So she made a second map, with the two bridges drawn very big and one of them crossed out.
Now the visitor finds the theatre, the museum and the restaurant, and nobody visits the police station by accident.
Sofia keeps every old map in a box. She says a wrong map still tells you where somebody went.
